title: RBI's Second Data Centre Opened in Bhubaneswar, Odisha
summary: RBI establishes its 2nd greenfield Tier-IV certified data centre in Bhubaneswar (Primary DC: Kharghar, Navi Mumbai).

blocks.content: RBI inaugurated its **2nd high-security greenfield Data Centre in Bhubaneswar, Odisha** (achieving Tier IV certification), supplementing its primary data centre in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai.
